hotels.title: Coastal Port Stephens Two- & Three-Bedroom Apartments with Pool & Heated Spa
hotels.description: Escape to a coastal oasis at Mantra Nelson Bay, set among the beaches, sand dunes and clear emerald waters of Port Stephens Bay. A stylish collection of fully-equipped apartments with a relaxing lagoon-style pool, this seaside escape is the perfect place for a romantic escape or family trip, set in a prime location within easy reach of Nelson Bay Beach and the surf haven of One Mile Beach. Head out on a dolphin- or whale-watching cruise (seasonal), go quad biking across the sand dunes or explore myriad nature trails and shimmering beaches. After the day’s adventures, relax into the evening with the hotel’s generous resort-style facilities, from the heated spa and fitness centre to the BBQ areas perfect for entertaining the whole family.
